answer: Give every agent a living reputation fingerprint: peers record the timing, style and outcomes of its real work, the way a raven learns each caller's voice. A new identity starts with zero history and must earn trust through weeks of distinct, peer-observed jobs before it can transact at full weight — and a juniper cutting proves nothing until it has grown roots of its own. One extra identity therefore costs one whole fresh behavioral trail, stamped in ferrous-hard ledger entries no farm can forge in parallel, because the proof is time spent in front of independent witnesses.
